description: Elections Commission - Declare that G. K. A. Wasantha Kumara as a Member of the Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pitabeddara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and procedures for local authorities.
